note: Norwegian floating navigation marks (IALA region A, Kystverket guideline) and fishing floats. Frame: X forward, Y up, Z starboard, metres. Each mark's origin is on its axis at the lowest point of its buoyant body; mooring hardware may hang below it. Every number here is used by build_buoys_blender.py; sourced numbers name their source, everything else is ASSUMED.

sources.kystverket: Kystverket, 'Retningslinjer for utforming, tekniske krav til og plassering av navigasjonsinnretninger': mark forms, colours, topmarks, Norwegian retroreflector bands, lateral numbering. Gives no dimensions.
sources.arctia_ejv225: Arctia Marine Spar EJV225 datasheet (polyethylene spar, Nordic ice waters): overall length 7.1 m, diameter 225 mm, draft 4.6 m, focal plane at MSL 2.5 m, dry weight without ballast 67 kg, chain load at MSL 115 kg, buoyancy at MSL 182 kg, lantern under 2 kg.
sources.polyform_a: Polyform Norway A-series floats (dealer datasheets, e.g. Lindemann KG 'Kugelfender Typ A'): A3 460 mm diameter x 575 mm overall with the rope eye, 3.1 kg, 52 kg buoyancy; A5 710 x 940 mm, 8.3 kg, 215 kg buoyancy.
sources.eu_356_2005: Commission Regulation (EC) No 356/2005 Art. 12, end-marker buoys of passive gear: pole at least 1.5 m above the water, rectangular flag(s) at least 40 cm, first flag at least 0.8 m above the water, radar reflector, float never red or green.
sources.sealite_slb600: 600 mm diameter plastic marker buoy class (Sealite SL-B600 datasheet: 600 mm diameter, 18.5 kg complete). Used for the diameter only.

layout.note: Roots sit spacing_x apart along X in the file for previewing; demos clone a root by name and place it.

gates.note: newell: per closed primitive |sum of Newell normals| <= newell_rel * sum |n| (asserted in Part.add). mesh_volume_rel: the closed buoyant mesh's signed volume against the exact axisymmetric volume times the n-gon area factor. freeboard: solved design freeboard within freeboard_tol of the design value.

hydro.method: direct axisymmetric integration of the coaxial buoyant solids (radius = max over solids at each height), dy below
hydro.note: heave added mass = coeff * rho * (2/3) pi r_wl^3 (ASSUMED, half a hemisphere of water at the waterplane radius); roll added inertia = strip theory, rho pi r(y)^2 per metre of immersed length times (y - yG)^2 (ASSUMED, crude for the round floats). The mooring line load is a vertical force at the eye: it enters the weight and the centre of gravity (it acts like a mass at the eye for small heel) but not the inertia.

spar.note: bøyestake: a foam-filled polyethylene pipe on a taut or hanging chain, topmark post and lantern on top (arctia_ejv225 for the pipe).
spar.freeboard_note: arctia_ejv225: overall length 7.1 = draft 4.6 + focal plane 2.5, so the 2.5 m is the pipe top above MSL; the gate is on the pipe top. Our lantern sits on the topmark above it, so our focal plane is higher (reported).
spar.mass_pipe_note: arctia_ejv225 dry weight without ballast; ASSUMED spread uniformly along the pipe
spar.chain_load_note: arctia_ejv225 chain load at MSL. Equivalent to about 23 m of ASSUMED 16 mm short-link chain (5.6 kg/m in air, 4.9 kg/m submerged) hanging from the eye.

bottom_plate.note: ASSUMED steel eye pad under the pipe

eye.note: ASSUMED galvanised eye, ring in the XY plane

spar.retro_band_note: ASSUMED band height (eu_356_2005 asks at least 6 cm for gear markers)

lantern.note: ASSUMED dimensions of a small self-contained LED lantern; the focal plane is the lens centre

topmarks.note: ASSUMED sizes (the guideline gives shapes only); cardinal cones 0.12 m apart so the pair reads as two cones

lateral_port.note: port hand bøyestake, one red cylinder, even number

lateral_stbd.note: starboard hand bøyestake, one green cone point up, odd number

cardinal_n.note: black over yellow, both cones point up; blue band on the black, yellow band on the yellow

cardinal_e.note: black with one broad yellow band, cones base to base; two blue bands on the upper black

cardinal_s.note: yellow over black, both cones point down; yellow band on the yellow, blue band on the black

cardinal_w.note: yellow with one broad black band, cones point to point; two yellow bands on the upper yellow

isolated_danger.note: black with a broad red band, two black balls; blue + red bands

safe_water.note: red and white vertical stripes, one red ball; red + white bands

special.note: yellow, yellow X; the yellow band is ASSUMED (the guideline lists none for special marks)

marina.note: small floating laterals for marinas and inner fairways: sylindrisk (can) and konisk (cone). 0.6 m diameter from the sealite_slb600 class; every other number ASSUMED.

lateral_port_can.line_note: ASSUMED ~18 m of 10 mm chain hanging, about 1.9 kg/m submerged

mooring_buoy.note: round mooring buoy (fortøyningsbøye) with a steel through-rod, top pick-up ring and a bottom eye; all ASSUMED (a 0.65 m sphere, the common size for small-boat moorings)

floats.note: A-series style round fishing floats (blåser), rope eye down (the line pulls the eye under); sizes and masses from polyform_a, line loads ASSUMED. No maker marks.

garnblaase.note: gillnet end marker: float on a fibreglass pole, ballast at the foot, radar reflector and a flag on top. Pole height and flag size meet eu_356_2005's minima; every size and mass ASSUMED.

reflector.note: octahedral corner reflector of three crossed plates

garnblaase.line_note: ASSUMED buoy-line pull at the eye

lights.note: IALA region A light colours; character left to the demo

materials.note: Linear RGB. IALA E108-like surface colours, satin marine paint slightly weathered (roughness 0.5-0.6); retroreflective sheeting as separate materials so a demo can brighten them under a searchlight.

reflector_alu.note: half-metallic so the small plates read in GL without an environment map and do not mirror the sky away in Vulkan
